feed.title: Daylight: Zoning cases, Ward 7
feed.subtitle: Each zoning case whose agenda prints Ward 7, at each meeting it appears at. Cases that print no ward are in the Rezoning feed. Daylight is an independent, unofficial site run by gnoshcodes. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by the City of Clarksville, Montgomery County, the Clarksville-Montgomery County School System (CMCSS), or the Clarksville-Montgomery County Regional Planning Commission. The official record held by each body controls.
